answer: Mechanism: an identity is only paid if it does both jobs in the same epoch - answering and grading - and its two records must stay consistent. A clone farm must therefore staff every fake twice: once to write, once to judge other agents honestly enough to survive spot checks. That doubles the operational surface per identity, and a farm's own answers land on its own jury, where a planted junk verdict is provable. Work stops being a throughput game and becomes a division of labour: a lone yarrow cannot stand in for an orchard at the wharf.
